$comment: Type-check ONLY (noEmit). Not a build config — esbuild and jest never read it. The JSDoc types are already written and linted; this checks them against the code. Run: npm run lint:types The `paths` block mirrors TARGETS in ../newspack-nodes/src/build-kit/alias-map.cjs, resolved against the SIBLING substrate checkout — the same assumption scripts/sync-shared-scripts.sh makes. Without it the build aliases are invisible and every aliased import reads as a missing module. The `react` / `react/*` entries are NOT redundant: this repo and the sibling substrate each carry their own @types/react, so shared components pulled in through the aliases resolve a DIFFERENT nominal CSSProperties than this repo's JSX expects, and every style prop crossing the boundary fails. Pinning both to this repo's copy gives the two trees one identity.
